snippet.title: Bastion Rivals – Official Gameplay Trailer | Updated Graphics
snippet.description:
Target release: 14 January 2027, subject to Steam approval.

Build the army. Break the bastion.

Wishlist Bastion Rivals on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5423790/Bastion_Rivals/

Four factions. Two lanes. Build your economy, recruit an army, upgrade your forces and push for the enemy castle. This updated trailer shows the new unit and building graphics and improved spacing in arranged native gameplay scenes.

Single-player is playable; online modes and ranked play are planned for launch. Launch timing remains subject to Steam approval.

Music: Clash Defiant by Kevin MacLeod
https://incompetech.com/

#BastionRivals #RTS #StrategyGames Inspiration & thanks
Bastion Rivals is inspired by Castle Fight, the Warcraft III custom map originally created by geX (also known as gekko). Special thanks to geX and the Castle Fight community for the inspiration and years of castle battles.
